REJECT
The diff alone doesn't show the method is at or below 15: the parts it does show still score about 11, and the unseen code before line 347 and around the delta/ternary section likely pushes it past the threshold.

I couldn't check this against the source, because every search and read in this environment came back empty. The extracted helpers do look like faithful moves, so behaviour and the build seem fine as far as the diff shows; the complexity condition is the one that can't be confirmed.
